quotes.text: They hardly compare against the conventional next-token-prediction objective, which suggests they don't beat it. Machine learning papers often tend to focus exclusively on the positives without mentioning the bad aspects.
quotes.author: cubefox
quotes.source: Hacker News — Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
quotes.extraction_note: Sharp read-the-rooms observation about what researchers *don't* benchmark — the missing comparison is the tell. Works standalone as a general truth about hype papers.
